title: Harden schema-invalid closure blocker attribution
description: Follow-up from the fail-closed finding-registry repair. findingRegistryClosureBlockers currently conservatively returns canonical row identities when parseRegistry rejects malformed registry structure; refine the parse-error path to attribute schema-invalid blockers as narrowly as possible while preserving fail-closed behavior. This is outside the assigned bead's required derived-generator and snapshot cases.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed registry fixtures report the narrowest available blocker identities, valid derived snapshot mismatches still report only the affected canonical row, and the closure gate remains fail-closed.
close_reason: RETIRE/SUPERSEDE (2026-10-09 rebaseline, verified on main a961fb0b): obsolete target. findingRegistryClosureBlockers no longer exists; registry v2 explicitly provides no closure-readiness predicate (explicitNonClaims). Nothing left to harden. No defect hidden.
